title: erythraea pumila
intro: Erythraea pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Fringed Pink, is a flowering plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Erythraea pumila include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe respiratory tract irritations and promote the removal of mucus. The bioactive constituents of Erythraea pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
